audience: Codex users who want deliberate subagent delegation without replacing their chosen main model.
oneSentenceValue: Keep the current model; finish simple tasks directly; delegate only worthwhile independent work.
primaryProof: A policy diagram and labeled illustrative routing scenarios, backed by the local routing script and tests; not live dispatch telemetry.
firstSuccessfulAction: Install the Skill, then ask for a read-only audit or run the audit command.
visualTheme: An editorial routing fork that visibly preserves a direct path.

artDirection.typography: Segoe UI / Microsoft YaHei / system sans-serif; title 52, route labels 24, supporting 20; mobile essential type 28+ on a 720-unit canvas.
artDirection.shape: 28-unit canvas radius; 16-unit route corners; 3-unit connectors; generous clear space.
artDirection.motif: Current main thread branches into direct work or worthwhile delegation, then owns acceptance.
artDirection.composition: Title above a horizontal decision fork on desktop; a simplified stacked fork on mobile.

preserve: All routing implementation and installed payload files
note: Earlier source/readme-brief.json, visual-brief.json and mz-intent.json are historical design inputs, not validation of this refresh.
